title: Legendre compressions and an integrality conjecture for the Hörmander--Bernhardsson extremal function
summary: We prove Conjecture~2 of Bondarenko, Ortega-Cerdà, Radchenko, and Seip for the three-term recurrence attached to the Hörmander--Bernhardsson extremal function $\varphi$. More precisely, define \[ \widetilde u_{-1}=0,\qquad \widetilde u_0=1, \] and \[ \widetilde u_{n+1} = \frac{4n+2}{n+1}\bigl(n(n+1)-λ\bigr)\widetilde u_n + \frac{4n}{n+1}x\,\widetilde u_{n-1}. \] Then \[ \widetilde u_n(x,λ)\in\mathbb Z[x,λ] \qquad(n\ge0). \] The proof is a determinant comparison in the scaled Legendre basis.
